Client timeout: set 10s for UI request; server-side retry/backoff: exponential with jitter, max retries 2
Use streaming responses for perceived latency — render tokens progressively
Trim system prompts and minimize context window; prefer slot-based retrieval to limit prompt size
Enable prefix KV caching for repeated system/context to reduce token compute
